content.clinical_topic: Chronic Kidney Disease and Atrial Fibrillation
content.guideline_summary: The document covers clinical guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation (AF) in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and on dialysis. It discusses the efficacy and safety of various anticoagulants including warfarin, rivaroxaban, and apixaban in these populations.

key_points.title: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)/Kidney Failure
key_points.summary: This section discusses evidence on the use of anticoagulants in patients with both AF and CKD. It includes systematic reviews and clinical trials analyzing the risk and benefits of different anticoagulant therapies.

key_points.title: AF with End-Stage or Dialysis-Dependent Chronic Kidney Disease
key_points.summary: This section provides data on the outcomes of anticoagulant use in AF patients with end-stage renal disease or those undergoing dialysis.
